algorithm: TPGD Algorithm 1, implemented directly with both phases and Equation (5)
scope: Gaussian-noise exact-RIP instances satisfying the machine-checkable assumptions; finite scoped corroboration of the paper's high-probability theorems

claim_3.source_statement: Corollary 5.3 gives population error of order sigma^2 d k/(N T), and the following paragraph compares it with d k^2/(N T).
claim_3.machine_contract: Across independently selected one-factor grids, direct TPGD's final parameter error must have log-log slopes within 0.25 of (+1,+1,-1,-1) for (d,k,T,N); every 95% seed-bootstrap slope interval must be reported.
claim_3.verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all four strict slope gates, assumptions, independent checker, and task-permutation negative control pass.

claim_4.source_statement: At fixed condition number and normalized step sizes, the paper reports iteration complexity independent of d,k,T,N up to logarithmic factors.
claim_4.machine_contract: For each of d,k,T,N varied over four values and six seeds, all runs must hit relative squared error 0.05; absolute log-log median-iteration slope must be at most 0.25 and maximum/minimum median ratio at most 2.
claim_4.verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all 96 runs hit the target and every factor, assumption, checker, and negative-control gate passes.

claim_5.source_statement: Theorem 5.1 assumes N of order at least sigma^2(d+T)k kappa^4/sigma_k^2.
claim_5.machine_contract: Use an N grid selected independently of the expression. Calibrate the hidden constant on seeds 8501-8505, freeze it, then require every held-out group with N/expression >= 10 to succeed on seeds 8601-8605 across all five factor families. Also require all largest-N groups to succeed, low-ratio failures, correct sigma^2/d+T/k threshold slopes, negative sigma_k direction, assumptions, checker, and a failing task-permutation control.
claim_5.verdict_rule: VERIFIED as finite sufficient-condition corroboration only if every held-out gate passes; no claim is made that the sufficient expression is a tight necessary transition.

non_circularity.claims_3_4: The powers-of-two grids, seeds, horizon, and tolerances were committed before outcomes and were not derived from fitted slopes.
non_circularity.claim_5: N=[32,...,4096] was fixed independently of the theorem expression. The margin C=10 was frozen from an immutable failed calibration run before the held-out seed set was executed.
